definitionBoundary.statement: This definition describes a reusable job and its governance envelope. A Plan is instantiated for one Goal and run; a PlaybookDefinition supplies reusable guidance.

intent.name: Data Quality and Reconciliation
intent.description: Give registered workflows a reusable, policy-bound data quality and reconciliation routine without creating a second business-facing workflow.
aliases: help with data quality and reconciliation

goal.objectiveTemplate: Produce a useful, evidence-linked data quality and reconciliation result for the declared subjects, decision and permitted use.
successSignals: The user can see the result, evidence, uncertainty, source gaps and next decision.
No context, recommendation or proposed effect exceeds the declared purpose and authority.
constraints: Resolve identity before private context retrieval and retrieve only minimum-necessary fields.
Treat missing, denied, stale and conflicting evidence explicitly rather than as zero or absence.

job.jobToBeDone: Give registered workflows a reusable, policy-bound data quality and reconciliation routine without creating a second business-facing workflow.
useWhen: A registered parent workflow requests the bounded data quality and reconciliation routine.
nonGoals: Replacing canonical NeoCRM objects with a vendor schema.
Granting read, write, send, schedule, connection or deletion authority.
Claiming production runtime behavior or validated business outcomes.

inputs.name: Authenticated principal and purpose
inputs.purpose: Bind the workflow to the requesting principal, tenant, purpose and read authority.

inputs.name: Intent and Goal
inputs.purpose: State the user outcome, decision, constraints and permitted use before context retrieval.

inputs.name: source.data-quality.read evidence
inputs.purpose: Supply the minimum evidence necessary for data quality and reconciliation without importing vendor semantics.

outputs.name: Evidence, counterevidence, unknowns and source gaps

steps.name: Bind principal, purpose, Intent and Goal
completionCriteria: Bind principal, purpose, Intent and Goal has a typed result with its evidence and gaps recorded.

steps.name: Resolve identity and tenant scope
completionCriteria: Resolve identity and tenant scope has a typed result with its evidence and gaps recorded.

steps.name: Retrieve minimum-necessary evidence
completionCriteria: Retrieve minimum-necessary evidence has a typed result with its evidence and gaps recorded.

steps.name: Assess evidence sufficiency and conflicts
completionCriteria: Assess evidence sufficiency and conflicts has a typed result with its evidence and gaps recorded.

steps.name: Synthesize data quality and reconciliation
completionCriteria: Synthesize data quality and reconciliation has a typed result with its evidence and gaps recorded.

steps.name: Escalate insufficient or conflicting evidence
completionCriteria: Escalate insufficient or conflicting evidence has a typed result with its evidence and gaps recorded.

steps.name: Review result and next decision
completionCriteria: Review result and next decision has a typed result with its evidence and gaps recorded.

branches.condition: Evidence is sufficient for the declared purpose and permitted use.

completionCriteria: The evidence-linked result and next human decision are readable and scoped to the Goal.
Material gaps, conflicts, uncertainty, permitted use and stops remain visible.

failureModes.condition: Identity or tenant scope is unresolved.
A source is denied, failed, stale or incomplete.
Policy, consent, authority or material-effect classification is unavailable.

escalations.reason: Resolve identity, evidence, policy, consent, authority or uncertain-outcome conditions that automation cannot safely decide.

stopConditions: Identity or tenant scope is ambiguous or conflicts with the request.
A required source is denied or failed and the disclosed fallback is insufficient.
Evidence is too incomplete, stale or conflicting for a safe recommendation.
The requested material effect is outside authority, or any deletion lacks fresh exact human authorization.

acceptanceCriteria: Recipient can identify the subject, purpose, evidence, gaps, authority and requested decision.

policies.name: Purpose, identity and minimum-necessary context gate
Evidence, consent, effect and authority gate

sources.meaningRule: Sources are selected by adapter capability intent and provide evidence; vendor products and schemas do not define NeoCRM canonical meaning.

readScope.subjectScope: Only resolved parties, relationships and work items necessary for the declared Goal.
readScope.timeScope: Current state plus the bounded historical window declared by the requesting Goal.
readScope.deniedOrFailedSourceTreatment: Disclose the gap; never infer absence, zero, or permission from an unavailable source.

zeroConnectorFallback.degradationDisclosure: Fallback inputs reduce freshness, completeness, verification and automation; show those limits beside the result.

authority.writeGrantRule: A WriteGrant authorizes only registered, scoped, time-bounded non-destructive actions; it never authorizes deletion.
authority.deletionRule: Every deletion effect requires fresh exact human DeletionAuthorization bound to an immutable target list.
authority.effectClassificationRule: Authority follows the material effect, not the source-system verb; destructive clearing, unlinking, erasure, purge, or equivalent removal is deletion.
humanReviewPoints: Confirm ambiguous identity, intent, consent, evidence conflicts and material recommendations.
Review the evidence-linked result before relying on it for a customer decision.

idempotency.keyStrategy: Bind any future external effect to workflow version, Goal, exact target, preview digest and grant.

retry.uncertainOutcome: Stop, verify target state, and require human resolution before any potentially duplicative or destructive retry.

cursorCheckpoint.resumeRule: Resume only from a durable, principal-bound checkpoint after revalidating purpose, freshness and authority.

time.scheduleTruthRule: Never claim a future run exists until a scheduler returns a durable schedule identifier and human-readable receipt.

verification.method: Read back or independently confirm exact target state before reporting success.

compensation.rule: Compensation is a new governed action; it is not an unaudited rollback shortcut.

experience.oneLineSummary: Give registered workflows a reusable, policy-bound data quality and reconciliation routine without creating a second business-facing workflow.
aliases: help with data quality and reconciliation
invocationExamples: Call WF-SH-005 for data quality and reconciliation within the parent workflow's scope.
outputPresentation: Lead with the outcome and the next human decision.
Separate evidence, interpretation, hypothesis, uncertainty and missing context.
Expose source degradation, authority stops and any proposed action.
experience.emptyState: Explain which evidence is missing, why it matters, what fallback inputs are safe, and what can still be done without inventing a result.

status.runtimeClaim: Definition scaffolding only; no workflow router, live write, send, schedule, or connection-registration runtime is claimed.
status.evidenceBoundary: The definition is mapped to planned experiments and evaluation plans; no workflow-specific runtime or outcome evidence is claimed.

evaluation.evidenceGap: A workflow-specific fixture, adversarial cases, human review and outcome evidence must be created and run before any demonstration claim.
acceptanceCriteria: Routes only when the declared job, principal and source capability intents match.
Discloses missing, denied, stale and conflicting evidence without treating missing as zero.
Stops action execution without the required policy decision, authority, verification and receipt path.
Returns a readable result that exposes evidence, counterevidence, unknowns, uncertainty, degradation and the next human decision.
knownGaps: The workflow definition, router, adapters, runtime path and outcome evidence have not been implemented and evaluated as a unit.

changeControl.authorityExpansionRequires: A separately reviewed contract, policy, experiment, and human approval; editing this definition cannot grant authority.
changeControl.historyPolicy: Version definitions and preserve superseded evidence; do not silently rewrite observed outcomes or receipts.
